notes: 模組自帶 Language 資料夾（english、zh-CN 等），依遊戲的語言名稱載入同名資料夾；沒有 zh-TW，選繁體中文時會顯示英文。english 資料夾名稱和遊戲的 en 對不上，實際的英文是程式用 R2API 註冊的，這裡的 en 取自程式。
有簡體翻譯的條目以模組自帶的 zh-CN 轉成繁體後對照英文修訂，其餘由英文翻譯。
技能說明裡的傷害倍率與彈數來自模組設定（預設值）；改過設定的話，譯文的數字要自己修改。
遊戲本體也有官方的 Enforcer（執行者）；這個模組的角色依模組自己的簡體翻譯叫「執法者」，兩者可以分辨。

ENFORCER_DESCRIPTION.en:
The Enforcer is a defensive juggernaut who can take and give a beating.<color=#CCD3E0>

< ! > Riot Shotgun can pierce through many enemies at once.

< ! > Batting away enemies with Shield Bash guarantees you will keep enemies at a safe range.

< ! > Use Tear Gas to weaken large crowds of enemies, then get in close and crush them.

< ! > When you can, use Protect and Serve against walls to prevent enemies from flanking you.
ENFORCER_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW:
執法者是一名防禦型的重裝巨漢，既能承受痛擊，也能痛毆敵人。<color=#CCD3E0>

< ! > 鎮暴霰彈槍可以一次穿透多名敵人。

< ! > 用盾擊把敵人打飛，就能確保敵人始終與你保持安全距離。

< ! > 使用催淚瓦斯削弱大群敵人，再貼近將他們粉碎。

< ! > 情況允許時，背靠牆壁使用保護與服務，防止敵人從側翼包抄你。

ENFORCER_LORE.en:
<style=cMono>"You don't have to do this."</style>

The words echoed in his head, yet he pushed forward. The pod was only a few steps away — he had a chance to leave — but something in his core kept him moving. He didn't know what it was, but he didn't question it. It was a natural force: the same force that always drove him to follow orders.

This time, however, it didn't seem so natural. There were no orders. The heavy trigger and its rhythmic thunder were his — and his alone.
ENFORCER_LORE.zh-TW:
<style=cMono>「你不必這麼做。」</style>

這句話在他腦海中迴響，但他仍舊向前邁進。逃生艙只在幾步之外——他有機會離開——但他內心深處的某種東西驅使他繼續前進。他不知道那是什麼，但他沒有質疑。那是一股自然而然的力量：正是那股一直驅使他服從命令的力量。

然而這一次，它似乎沒那麼自然了。沒有任何命令。那沉重的扳機與它節奏分明的雷鳴，是屬於他的——只屬於他一個人。

ENFORCER_OUTRO_FLAVOR.en: ..and so he left, unsure of his title as protector.
ENFORCER_OUTRO_FLAVOR.zh-TW: ……於是他走了，不再確定自己是否還稱得上是守護者。

ENFORCER_OUTRO_FAILURE.en: ..and so he vanished, the planet's minorities finally at peace.
ENFORCER_OUTRO_FAILURE.zh-TW: ……於是他消失了，這顆星球上的少數族群終於得以安寧。

ENFORCER_PRIMARY_SHOTGUN_DESCRIPTION.en: Fire a short-range blast that <style=cIsUtility>pierces</style> for <style=cIsDamage>6x60% damage.</style>

Fire up to 2 shotgun blasts for <style=cIsDamage>8x80% damage</style>.
While using <style=cIsUtility>Protect and Serve</style>, fire <style=cIsDamage>both barrels at once.</style>

最多可連續發射2發霰彈，每發造成<style=cIsDamage>8x80%傷害</style>。
使用<style=cIsUtility>保護與服務</style>時，改為<style=cIsDamage>雙管齊發。</style>

ENFORCER_PRIMARY_RIFLE_DESCRIPTION.en:
Unload a barrage of bullets for <style=cIsDamage>130% damage</style>.
While using <style=cIsUtility>Protect and Serve</style>, has <style=cIsDamage>increased accuracy</style>, but <style=cIsHealth>slower movement speed</style>.

Swing your hammer for <style=cIsDamage>500% damage</style>.
While using Protect and Serve, swing in a <style=cIsUtility>larger area</style>, for <style=cIsDamage>1000% damage</style> instead.

KEYWORD_SPRINTBASH.en:
<style=cKeywordName>Shoulder Bash</style><style=cSub><style=cIsDamage>Stunning.</style> A short charge that deals <style=cIsDamage>450% damage</style>.
Hitting <style=cIsDamage>heavier enemies</style> deals <style=cIsDamage>700% damage</style>.
KEYWORD_SPRINTBASH.zh-TW:
<style=cKeywordName>肩撞</style><style=cSub><style=cIsDamage>眩暈。</style>向前短距離衝撞，造成<style=cIsDamage>450%傷害</style>。
撞擊<style=cIsDamage>較重的敵人</style>時改為造成<style=cIsDamage>700%傷害</style>。

ENFORCER_SECONDARY_BASH_DESCRIPTION.en:
<style=cIsDamage>Stunning</style>. Knock back enemies for <style=cIsDamage>350% damage</style> and <style=cIsUtility>deflect projectiles</style>.
While <style=cIsUtility>sprinting</style>, perform a <style=cIsDamage>Shoulder Bash</style> instead.

<style=cIsDamage>眩暈</style>。擊退敵人並造成<style=cIsDamage>350%傷害</style>，同時<style=cIsUtility>反彈射彈</style>。
<style=cIsUtility>衝刺</style>時改為施展<style=cIsDamage>肩撞</style>。

KEYWORD_BLINDED.en: <style=cKeywordName>Impaired</style><style=cSub>Reduce movement speed by <style=cIsDamage>75%</style>, attack speed by <style=cIsDamage>25%</style> and armor by <style=cIsDamage>30</style>.</style></style>
KEYWORD_BLINDED.zh-TW: <style=cKeywordName>失能</style><style=cSub>使移動速度降低<style=cIsDamage>75%</style>、攻擊速度降低<style=cIsDamage>25%</style>，護甲降低<style=cIsDamage>30</style>。</style></style>

ENFORCER_UTILITY_STUNGRENADE_DESCRIPTION.en: <style=cIsDamage>Stunning</style>. Launch a grenade that concusses enemies for <style=cIsDamage>540% damage</style>. Hold up to 3.

ENFORCER_UTILITY_SHOCKGRENADE_DESCRIPTIO.en: <style=cIsDamage>Shocking</style>. Launch a grenade that electrocutes enemies for <style=cIsDamage>720% damage</style>. Hold up to 3.

ACHIEVEMENT_ENFORCER_DOOMINTERNALUNLOCKA.en: As Enforcer, kill 10 imp overlords in a single run.

NEMFORCER_DESCRIPTION.en:
Nemesis Enforcer is an incarnation of valiance and strength, a supernatural kind who is nobody to take lightly.<color=#CCD3E0>

< ! > Golden Hammer can hit many enemies at once.

< ! > Use Dominance from high up to perform a devastating slam.

< ! > Strafing with Golden Minigun is key to taking down powerful bosses.

< ! > Shields are for pussies.
NEMFORCER_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW:
復仇執法者是勇氣與力量的化身，是絕對不容小覷的超自然存在。<color=#CCD3E0>

< ! > 黃金之錘可以一次擊中多名敵人。

< ! > 從高處使用統治，就能施展毀滅性的猛砸。

< ! > 拿著黃金迷你炮邊移動邊掃射，是擊倒強大頭目的關鍵。

< ! > 盾牌是給膽小鬼用的。

NEMFORCER_OUTRO_FLAVOR.en: ..and so he left, with newfound might to honor.

NEMFORCER_OUTRO_FAILURE.en: ..and so he returned, infallible bastion truly immortalized.
NEMFORCER_OUTRO_FAILURE.zh-TW: ……於是他回來了，永不陷落的堡壘從此真正永垂不朽。

ENFORCER_EVENT_NEMFORCERBOSS_START.en: An unnatural force emanates from the void... </style>
ENFORCER_EVENT_NEMFORCERBOSS_START.zh-TW: 一股不自然的力量從虛空中散發而出……</style>

NEMFORCER_PASSIVE_REWORK_DESCRIPTION.en: Nemesis Enforcer regenerates <style=cIsHealing>0.02%</style> of his <style=cIsHealing>maximum health</style> over 3s when striking enemies with <style=cIsDamage>melee attacks</style>.
NEMFORCER_PASSIVE_REWORK_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 復仇執法者以<style=cIsDamage>近戰攻擊</style>擊中敵人時，會在3秒內再生<style=cIsHealing>最大生命值</style>的<style=cIsHealing>0.02%</style>。

NEMFORCER_UTILITY_CRASH_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: <style=cIsUtility>擒拿。</style>躍向空中，然後重砸地面，造成<style=cIsDamage>2400%傷害</style>。<style=cIsUtility>衝擊中心以外的傷害會降低。</style>

NEMFORCER_SPECIAL_MINIGUNUP_DESCRIPTION.en: Take an offensive stance, <style=cIsDamage>readying your minigun</style>. <style=cIsHealth>Prevents sprinting</style>.
NEMFORCER_SPECIAL_MINIGUNUP_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 採取進攻姿態，<style=cIsDamage>架起迷你炮</style>。期間<style=cIsHealth>無法衝刺</style>。

ACHIEVEMENT_ENFORCER_NEMESIS2UNLOCKABLE_.en: As Enforcer, on monsoon or higher, stabilize the Void Fields and defeat Enforcer's Vestige.
ACHIEVEMENT_ENFORCER_NEMESIS2UNLOCKABLE_.zh-TW: 作為執法者，在季風或更高難度下穩定虛空之境，並擊敗執法者的殘象。

ACHIEVEMENT_NEMFORCER_MASTERYUNLOCKABLE_.en: As Nemesis Enforcer, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
ACHIEVEMENT_NEMFORCER_MASTERYUNLOCKABLE_.zh-TW: 作為復仇執法者，在季風難度下通關遊戲或抹除自己。

ACHIEVEMENT_NEMFORCER_TYPHOONUNLOCKABLE_.zh-TW: 復仇執法者：大師級精通

ACHIEVEMENT_NEMFORCER_TYPHOONUNLOCKABLE_.en:
As Nemesis Enforcer, beat the game or obliterate on Typhoon or Eclipse.
<color=#8888>(Counts any difficulty Typhoon or higher)</color>
ACHIEVEMENT_NEMFORCER_TYPHOONUNLOCKABLE_.zh-TW:
作為復仇執法者，在颱風或日食難度下通關遊戲或抹除自己。
<color=#8888>（颱風以上的任何難度皆計入）</color>

ACHIEVEMENT_NEMFORCER_DOMINANCEUNLOCKABL.en: As Nemesis Enforcer, destroy 5 projectiles at once with Dominance.
ACHIEVEMENT_NEMFORCER_DOMINANCEUNLOCKABL.zh-TW: 作為復仇執法者，使用統治一次摧毀5枚射彈。
